purpose: Machine-readable notation glossary and regime definitions for all symbols used in the main manuscript and supplementary materials

model_variables.name: Inequality / Gini
model_variables.source: World Bank SI.POV.GINI under an exact affine map (OECD levels not used directly)

model_variables.name: Cultural intensity
model_variables.source: WVS 6-item aggregate (config/wvs_items.yaml); withdrawn: Cronbach alpha 0.348 below the 0.70 floor

model_variables.name: Trauma / shock
model_variables.source: EM-DAT total_deaths, standardized (UCDP battle deaths are not the same measure and are not used)
model_variables.note: T equals total_deaths exactly. A composite with total_affected was tested on an earlier panel revision and not adopted; it is not reproduced on the current panel.

model_variables.name: Social atomization
model_variables.source: WVS 5 configured items, 4 usable (config/wvs_items.yaml); withdrawn: Cronbach alpha -1.228

model_variables.name: Redistribution capacity
model_variables.source: OECD redistribution scenarios; withdrawn: disposable-income Gini is unavailable outside the OECD sample

model_variables.name: Education capacity
model_variables.source: World Bank SE.SEC.ENRR (secondary gross enrolment) under an exact affine map

model_variables.name: Social support
model_variables.source: WVS 7 configured items, 3 available (A101, A106, F185, F186 absent); not computable, 0 cells

model_variables.name: Welfare capacity
model_variables.source: UNDP HDI under an exact affine map: R = 7.303771 HDI - 6.005361

greek_letters.name: Contextual field
greek_letters.definition: φ₀ + Σcᵢ Mᵢ + Σ Iⱼ + Σ Qₖ

greek_letters.name: Estimation loss
greek_letters.definition: mean squared error between modelled and normalised observed Z (unpenalised)

hyperparameters.name: Half-saturation constant
hyperparameters.role: Saturation curve inflection; Z=0.5 when S=k

hyperparameters.name: Structural windows used by the fitting script
hyperparameters.role: Clip domain for the safe-band map during fitting

hyperparameters.name: Structural windows in the model contract
hyperparameters.role: Clip domain for the safe-band map in evaluation and the interface (differs from fitting; KI-18)

hyperparameters.name: Outcome anchors in the fitting script
Outcome anchors in the model contract
hyperparameters.role: Z_NORMALIZATION used for evaluation (differs from fitting; KI-18)

regime_definitions.label: Low-uptake
regime_definitions.empirical_characterization: Below-transition zone; outcome near floor. Marginal sensitivity ∂Z/∂Φ = Z(1−Z) is low. Low values of the belief-intensity composite.
regime_definitions.support_density: 27 of 207 (13.0%); thin support, extrapolation risk elevated.

regime_definitions.label: Ridge peak
regime_definitions.empirical_characterization: Narrow band around Z=0.5 (Φ+s ≈ 0) where ∂Z/∂Φ is maximal. Location determined by mapping geometry, not empirical discovery.

regime_definitions.label: High-uptake
regime_definitions.empirical_characterization: Above-transition zone; outcome near ceiling. Saturation compresses marginal effects. High values of the belief-intensity composite.

regime_definitions.label: Saturated tails
regime_definitions.empirical_characterization: Extreme floor/ceiling regions where ∂Z/∂Φ ≈ 0. Bounded map compresses effect sizes; apparent stability may reflect mapping mechanics rather than evidenced structure.
regime_definitions.support_density: 0 of 207 predictions fall below 0.05 or above 0.95; narratives here are prone to misinterpretation.
